hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Africa, southeast of Algeria || predominately desert plains and sand dunes; flat to rolling plains in south; hills in north || landlocked; one of the hottest countries in the world; northern four-fifths is desert, southern one-fifth is savanna that is suitable for livestock and limited agriculture || Resources: uranium, coal, iron ore, tin, phosphates, gold, molybdenum, gypsum, salt, petroleum || Exports: gold, oil seeds, uranium and thorium ore, radioactive chemicals, refined petroleum (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: predominately desert plains and sand dunes; flat to rolling plains in south; hills in north || Western Africa, southeast of Algeria

climate.excerpt: desert; mostly hot, dry, dusty; tropical in extreme south || recurring droughts

economy.excerpt: low-income Sahel economy; major instability and humanitarian crises limit economic activity; COVID-19 eliminated recent antipoverty gains; economy rebounding since December 2020 Nigerian border reopening and new investments; uranium resource rich || Exports: gold, oil seeds, uranium and thorium ore, radioactive chemicals, refined petroleum (2023) || Industries: uranium mining, petroleum, cement, brick, soap, textiles, food processing, chemicals, slaughterhouses
